cohort: Women aged 15 to 49 years who had a live birth in the 2 years prior to the survey in Bangladesh.
finding: Education, wealth index quintile, and antenatal care (ANC) visits are essential determinants for receiving skilled birth attendants and Caesarean sections during deliveries.
mod_finding: Education, wealth index quintile, and antenatal care (ANC) visits are essential determinants for Caesarean sections.
